description:
Johnjal is an interactive story experience where YOU step into the lead role of a cinematic drama.

Choose a scenario, become its protagonist, and make choices that shape how your story unfolds. Every world, character, and storyline is original content created and curated by our team, built to pull you in so you're not just reading a story, you're living it.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick an interactive scenario and step into the lead role
- Make choices at key moments that steer the drama
- Follow your own path through richly designed characters and worlds
- Return anytime to continue where you left off

ORIGINAL INTERACTIVE STORIES
- Top Star's Manager: Step into life behind the spotlight, where every decision shapes a world of fame, pressure, and secrets.
- Blue Gate Boarding House: Move into a boarding house full of charismatic housemates, each with a story waiting to unfold.
- A growing library of original dramas, with new scenarios added regularly.

WHY JOHNJAL
- Original characters, worlds, and visuals designed by our creative team
- Story-first design: immersive, cinematic scenarios instead of endless menus
- Your choices matter and shape each playthrough
- Fresh interactive dramas added over time

Johnjal is an entertainment app. All characters, names, and stories are entirely fictional, and any resemblance to real people is purely coincidental.

Have feedback or need help? Visit our support page and we'll be glad to help.
